About the job
Hegau Fahrzeugteile is a family-owned Tier-1 supplier of stamped and welded chassis and seat structure components. Our Polish plant in Pruszków near Warsaw employs 780 people in three shifts and supplies four European car makers.

After a difficult launch of two new vehicle platforms, the plant is currently on controlled shipping level 2 with one customer, and our plant manager has left the company. We are looking for an experienced interim plant manager who stabilises operations and hands over a healthy plant to the permanent successor.

Your responsibilities
• Full P&L responsibility for the plant (revenue of approx. EUR 190 million) and leadership of the management team (production, quality, logistics, maintenance, HR, finance)
• Exit from CS2 within the agreed timeline together with the customer and the quality team
• Stabilise the launch of the new platforms and raise OEE on the press and welding lines from 61 % to at least 75 %
• Roll out shopfloor management and a structured problem-solving routine (8D, PDCA) in all shifts
• Reduce scrap and premium freight and secure delivery performance
• Prepare the plant for the IATF 16949 recertification audit in spring 2027
• Report weekly to the Managing Director Operations at our headquarters in Germany

Your profile
• 15+ years in automotive manufacturing, of which at least 5 years as plant manager or head of production
• Proven turnaround experience in a Tier-1 environment, including customer escalations
• Strong lean manufacturing background; a Lean Six Sigma Black Belt is a plus
• Knowledge of IATF 16949, VDA 6.3 and the automotive core tools
• Fluent English; Polish or German is a strong plus
• Willingness to be on site five days a week

What we offer
• Interim contract for 9 months, extension possible
• Start: 1 November 2026
• Day rate EUR 1,000 to 1,150 plus a furnished apartment in Warsaw and weekly flights home
• Direct contract with Hegau Fahrzeugteile Polska; no temporary agency work
